summary: Delivery product remains directionally sound and conceptually mature. Strategic foundation (Delivery-as-Code design, schema, state policy, rendered packets, TDE pilot contract) continues to hold. Execution gap is persistent for a third consecutive nightly cycle: all three top priorities — pilot end-to-end, gate-to-contract upgrade, and scorecard operational — remain open with zero execution starts. Overnight 2026-03-16 was intensive but focused entirely on other product lanes (Vega/PXS E2 boundary, TDE assignment acceptance, archived-repo improvement). Delivery signals were carried forward without promotion for the second consecutive night. One new signal from Jobs Review: JOB-DEL-001 proof-case bundle is complete and should be retired/archived; the intra-Lyra handoff protocol should be formalized as a governance artifact. No priority changes required.
materialChanges: none — no Delivery product artifacts updated since 2026-03-16 nightly. JOB-DEL-001 retirement noted as a minor housekeeping signal. ACTIVATION.md and VERIFY.md expansion (PLAN step 3a, IMPLEMENT_NOW item 3-4) not yet executed; assembly files remain at 2026-03-14 state.

topPriorities.title: Run one real Delivery v0.1 pilot end to end and publish the evidence pack
topPriorities.note: Core scaffolding in place. Overnight 2026-03-16 noted this as a signal but did not promote it to active execution. Now in its second deferred overnight cycle. TDE_UI_PILOT_DELIVERY_CONTRACT_V1.md defines the minimum shape. ACTIVATION.md and VERIFY.md are drafted but not yet expanded to production-grade. Risk R-001 (verification debt) continues to accumulate.
topPriorities.nextStep: Select one representative Delivery v0.1 pilot in PXS; run the full VERIFY path; produce canonical evidence pack covering distribution lane, gate application, evidence captured, rollback credibility, pass/fail outcome.

topPriorities.title: Upgrade the Delivery gate from checklist to contract
topPriorities.note: Gate intent exists in DELIVERY_GATE_CHECKLIST.md. Risk R-003 (gate ambiguity) remains live and rises with each delivery unit run under the current thin checklist model. No execution started.
topPriorities.nextStep: Expand gate into a risk-classed contract with required checks, evidence outputs, explicit pass/fail logic, and at least one machine-checkable validation hook in the existing governance/validation pipeline.

topPriorities.title: Make Delivery measurement and review operational, not aspirational
topPriorities.note: Metric framework defined in METRICS.md. No baseline, no first weekly review run, no scorecard snapshot produced. Delivery review cadence (MODEL.yaml: weekly) has not been operationalised.
topPriorities.nextStep: Define minimal low-noise weekly scorecard snapshot; run first real weekly review against it; record one concrete follow-through improvement from the result.

constraints: No strategic launches without Peter involvement (MODEL.yaml critical_constraint).
Maintain verification and traceability discipline across all consuming products — this is also the core value Delivery must demonstrate in its own pilot.
Delivery owns the shipping system, not the full strategy of every product it serves (INTERFACES.md boundary rule).

Capacity constraint: overnight 2026-03-15 and 2026-03-16 both allocated to non-Delivery priorities (Vega/PXS boundary, TDE assignment acceptance, improvement loop). A third consecutive deferred cycle increases the risk that Delivery pilot never reaches a natural start trigger.
JOB-DEL-001 proof-case bundle (jobs directory) is complete; retirement + formalization of intra-Lyra handoff protocol as a governance artifact is a pending housekeeping item.

risksOrOpportunities.note: Core and persistent risk. Evidence gap has now spanned three nightly cycles without an execution start. ACTIVATION.md and VERIFY.md are still in their 2026-03-14 state. Mitigant (run the pilot) continues to be deferred. Trend moving from stable to rising.

risksOrOpportunities.label: Drift through interim copy distribution
risksOrOpportunities.note: INTERIM_COPY_SYNC_PROTOCOL.md exists. Migration toward TDE-native coordination is the stated direction but not yet operationalised. Not deteriorating.

risksOrOpportunities.note: Gate is still checklist-level with interpretive application risk. Rises with each delivery unit run prior to the contract upgrade. No new delivery units run that would have surfaced the gap since last cycle.

risksOrOpportunities.label: Security/authority regression under delivery pressure
risksOrOpportunities.note: No specific delivery-pressure events noted. Governance posture (medium) maintained. Archived-repo-misuse error from 2026-03-15 was fully closed overnight (all corrective actions implemented, CANONICAL_REPO_MAP_V1.md v1.1 updated with pre-edit repo-authority gate).

risksOrOpportunities.note: Three consecutive nightly reports have signalled P1 (pilot execution) as open and unstarted. Without an explicit time-boxed commitment or TDE work item, this may drift indefinitely as other product lane work crowds it out. Not yet critical but warrants escalation to Control Tower for scheduling decision.

researchDelta: none — no Delivery research artifacts updated or surfaced in this run. RADAR.md, DOCTRINE.md, IMPLICATIONS.md unchanged since prior cycle.

proposedTdeActions.description: P1 (pilot) has been open, unstarted, and deferred across three overnight cycles. Recommend Control Tower schedule an explicit time-boxed execution start for the Delivery v0.1 pilot (TDE_UI_PILOT_DELIVERY_CONTRACT_V1.md) as a TDE work item with an assigned owner and target window. Without this, R-NEW-001 (pilot-start drift) will become structural.
R-003 gate-ambiguity risk: recommend converting P2 (gate-to-contract) into a tracked TDE work item (estimated: 2-3h bounded effort) to prevent indefinite deferral.
P3 (scorecard/review): consider bundling the first Delivery weekly review as a sub-task within the next weekly review cycle. Low effort, high signal value for proving the measurement layer.

Housekeeping: JOB-DEL-001 proof-case bundle in jobs/ directory is complete (confirmed by Jobs Review 2026-03-16). Recommend archiving and formalizing the intra-Lyra handoff protocol as a governance artifact (OPS-2026-068 scope covers this).
